title: ActualsSummary
description: Period rollup of income, expenses, and cash for one enterprise. Money values are USD numbers with two-decimal convention. period is the reporting month label; income/expenses follow amountsBasis (which may be YTD, not that single month).

enterpriseId.description: Enterprise.id of the enterprise this summary belongs to.

period.description: Reporting month label in YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-10). Not necessarily the exclusive window for income/expenses — see amountsBasis.

amountsBasis.description: Window for income and expenses. fy-ytd = fiscal-year-to-date through period (council budget comparison style). monthly = that calendar month only. cashBalance is always an as-of snapshot for period, not controlled by this field.

income.description: Income / revenue actual for the window described by amountsBasis.

expenses.description: Expense actual for the window described by amountsBasis.

cashBalance.description: Cash / bank position for the enterprise as of the period snapshot (typically period month-end). Sum only the bank accounts listed in cashBalanceAccounts when that field is present.

cashBalanceAccounts.description: Bank account labels from the source bank-balances export that were summed into cashBalance.

schemaVersion.description: Optional human-readable contract version for this payload.
